question: Assistive Ball은 어떤 기능을 하나요?
english_query: What functions does the Assistive Ball have?

dense_candidates.title: Assistive Ball
dense_candidates.text:
Assistive Ball
Assistive Ball lets you complete different tasks quickly by using gestures or through the menu options. Path: Settings - System settings - Convenience tools - Assistive Ball.

dense_candidates.title: Use Assistive Ball to take a screenshot
dense_candidates.text:
Use Assistive Ball to take a screenshot
1. Go to "Settings - System settings - Convenience tools - Assistive Ball", and turn on "Assistive Ball". 2. Choose "Tap menu". 3. Tap the Assistive Ball and tap the Screenshot icon.

dense_candidates.title: Menu control
dense_candidates.text:
Menu control
In menu mode, tapping the Assistive Ball will display five buttons, which correspond to the following actions: • Go back to the previous page • Take a screenshot • Multitask • Lock the screen • Go back to the home screen To personalize your Assistive Ball: • Drag it to your preferred position on the screen. • Adjust its visibility. • Automatically hide it in full screen mode.

dense_candidates.title: Gesture controls
dense_candidates.text:
Gesture controls
• Tap the Assistive Ball to go back to the previous page. • Double-tap the Assistive Ball to enter multitask mode. • Tap and hold the Assistive Ball to go back to the home screen. You can customize gestures to suit your needs and preferences.

dense_candidates.title: Assistive tools
dense_candidates.text:
Assistive tools
• Assistive Ball: Enable Assistive Ball to make your phone easier to use.
• One-handed mode: In One-handed mode, the screen shrinks, so that you can use your phone with one hand.
• Auto rotate: The screen will automatically rotate when you rotate your phone.

dense_candidates.title: Call up the Game Assistant
dense_candidates.text:
Call up the Game Assistant
Call up the Game Assistant by swiping down from the top left of the screen while playing games.

dense_candidates.title: Game Assistant, your path to victory!
dense_candidates.text:
Game Assistant, your path to victory!
You can swipe to call up the Game Assistant while playing games. In this case, the Game Assistant is displayed in a small window, and you can take screenshots, screen recordings or use other features.

dense_candidates.title: Turn Switch Access on
dense_candidates.text:
Turn Switch Access on
Go to "Settings - System settings - Accessibility - Interaction - Switch Access", and turn the
switch on.

dense_candidates.title: Use TalkBack
dense_candidates.text:
Use TalkBack
Do the following: • Swipe right or left to switch between items. • Double-tap an item to activate it. • Swipe with two fingers to scroll.

dense_candidates.title: Turn TalkBack on
dense_candidates.text:
Turn TalkBack on
Go to "Settings - System settings - Accessibility - Vision - TalkBack", and turn the switch on.

dense_candidates.title: Accessibility Menu
dense_candidates.text:
Accessibility Menu
Accessibility Menu provides a large on-screen menu for phone control, so that you can easily and quickly find the UIs or features you want to access.
Convenience features

dense_candidates.title: Use Accessibility mode
dense_candidates.text:
Use Accessibility mode
Accessibility features are provided to help all our users enjoy using their OPPO phone. Path: Settings - System settings - Accessibility.

dense_candidates.title: Turn Accessibility Menu off
dense_candidates.text:
Turn Accessibility Menu off
Go to "Settings - System settings - Accessibility - General - Accessibility Menu", and turn the switch off. Note: You can tap and hold the icon in the lower right corner to switch between the Accessibility Menu and Select to Speak.

dense_candidates.title: Screenshot and screen recording
dense_candidates.text:
Screenshot and screen recording
You can use the Game Assistant to take screenshots and screen recordings while playing games.

dense_candidates.title: Personalized settings
dense_candidates.text:
Personalized settings
Adjust the settings of features such as Click when pointer stops, Press power button to end calls, and Touch & hold delay to suit your usage habits. Path: Settings - System settings - Accessibility.
